content.value_statement: Document analysis projects need correct SDK patterns for authentication, models, and results. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Azure Document Intelligence workflows in .NET.
actual_capabilities: Shows package setup for Azure.AI.DocumentIntelligence and Azure.Identity.
Explains Microsoft Entra ID and API key authentication patterns.
Demonstrates prebuilt invoice, receipt, layout, and classifier workflows.
Guides custom model and classifier creation from blob storage sources.
Lists key SDK types, build modes, and related Azure references.
Includes basic error handling for Azure RequestFailedException.
limitations: Requires an active Azure Document Intelligence resource and valid credentials.
Uses placeholder endpoints, document URLs, model IDs, and storage SAS URLs.
Does not include a complete runnable .NET project structure.
Does not cover Azure pricing, deployment, monitoring, or compliance review.

use_cases.title: Add Invoice Extraction
use_cases.description: Use prebuilt invoice models to extract vendor names, totals, and line items in a .NET application.

use_cases.title: Create Receipt Automation
use_cases.description: Build a workflow that reads receipt fields and routes normalized values to downstream business systems.

use_cases.title: Train Custom Document Models
use_cases.description: Plan custom model and classifier usage for specialized forms stored in Azure Blob Storage.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Basic Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a first document analysis call.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to show me how to analyze one PDF with Azure AI Document Intelligence in a .NET app.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Invoice Fields
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate use of a prebuilt business document model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a .NET invoice extraction flow that returns vendor, total, date, and line item values.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Layout and Tables
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate document parsing with pages and tables.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain how my .NET service should extract text, page lines, and tables from uploaded documents.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Custom Model Training
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for custom models and classifiers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a custom Document Intelligence model and classifier workflow using Azure Blob Storage training data.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to read an invoice PDF from a URL.
output_examples.output: The assistant outlines client authentication, selects the prebuilt invoice model, and describes how to read vendor and total fields.

output_examples.input: A team wants to extract tables from scanned reports.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends the layout model and explains how pages, lines, words, tables, rows, and cells are returned.

output_examples.input: A business needs a custom classifier for two document types.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes blob storage sources, document type labels, classifier creation, and confidence review after classification.

best_practices: Prefer Microsoft Entra ID with DefaultAzureCredential for production services.
Check field confidence before storing or acting on extracted values.
Reuse SDK client instances and handle long-running operations explicitly.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys, SAS tokens, or customer documents into prompts.
Do not assume placeholder sample URLs work in production code.
Do not delete or overwrite custom models without an operations review.

faq.question: What Azure service does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Azure AI Document Intelligence through the Azure.AI.DocumentIntelligence .NET SDK.

faq.question: Can it help with invoices and receipts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prebuilt invoice and receipt workflows with common extracted fields.

faq.question: Does it require Azure credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. You need an Azure endpoint and either Microsoft Entra ID access or an API key.

faq.question: Does it create a full application?
faq.answer: No. It provides SDK guidance and examples, not a complete production application.

faq.question: Can it guide custom model training?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes custom model and classifier workflows that use Azure Blob Storage sources.

faq.question: Is it limited to Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
